citation: Allen et al. (1998). FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56; Hargreaves and Samani (1982, 1985); Thornthwaite (1948), as cited by the repository.
description: PyETo is Mark Richards' Python library for estimating reference crop evapotranspiration and missing meteorological quantities. It implements FAO-56 Penman-Monteith, Hargreaves and Thornthwaite methods, with helper functions for humidity, radiation and other required terms. Inputs are meteorological observations and site parameters appropriate to the selected equation; outputs are reference evapotranspiration estimates. Geographic coverage is user-defined and the supported calculation interval depends on the method. Public source and online documentation are free under BSD-3-Clause. A limitation is that the repository labels the package pre-alpha and instructs users to incorporate source directly; its tested Python-version list ends at 3.8. Reference evapotranspiration also requires crop and management assumptions before it represents actual irrigation demand. PyETo can provide atmospheric-demand calculations for irrigation simulations, complementing the MODFLOW agricultural-water-use package (model-modflow-api-agricultural-water-use-package). The documentation explains required variables and estimation alternatives. No weather files were obtained and the numerical methods were not executed.
